title: The Surprising Solution to Burnout
subtitle: A keynote address.
body_html:
Radical Acceptance is hard. It is also crucial. I made this video for a Mental Health Themed event in the metaverse. May it rest…in peace. I hope you all enjoy it!

—Owen Scott Muir, M.D.
